text: You do not need to see the whole staircase. Just take the first step.
Discipline is choosing between what you want now and what you want most.
The future depends on what you do today.
You are allowed to become someone you have never been before.
when your planing to do something, you have to get ready to make 0 for a while.
learn by doing instead of asking what if.
if you dont start now, youll still be asking this same question months later -- just with more regret.
stop announcing what you dont have, start stacking proof of what you can do.

some days you'll pray tired, still counts.
some days skincare feels pointless, still do it.
some days learning feels slow, that's when it matters most.
IT'S ALL ABOUT STARTING WITH WHAT YOU HAVE AND BUILDING A FOUNDATION FROM THERE.
Lets suffer with aim, shall we?
